answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with an escalating external-proof ladder: every identity must publish a chain of independently attested proofs, signed work verified by outside third parties, and each extra identity sharing a funding source must present a chain twice as long. A whisper of fraud is caught since proofs are public and cross-checked; an ivory-tower registry run by the network itself would be gamed, so verification is outsourced to independent attestors. One extra identity costs a whole fresh ladder of externally verified work, copper-clad proof no farm can print.
